text: Harbour City abriu o placar no fim do 1º tempo com Elias Okafor e Marek Barros, num estilo paciente de passes curtos, garantindo 2 a 0 com chances pequenas de gol (xG 0.11 e 0.009, quase 1 chance certa em 10). Mas Seabrook Town dominou o jogo, com 22 chutes e xG total de 3.48 — ou seja, quase 3 vezes mais chances boas que o adversário [#905][#1104]. No 2º tempo, após apertar a marcação e jogar mais direto, Seabrook marcou 4 vezes, com Kian Romano fazendo os dois gols finais nos acréscimos, cada um quase certo de entrar (xG 0.61 e 0.96) [#1361][#1882][#1906]. Marek Barros foi o melhor em campo, mesmo no time que perdeu, com 1 gol, 2 assistências e 9 desarmes [#975]. O time visitante mostrou que paciência e jogo aberto podem virar uma partida emocionante!

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in pt

- Seabrook Town outshot Harbour City 22 to 10 and had a higher xG of 3.48 compared to Harbour City's 1.0, showing greater scoring chances overall. [#1104][#905]
- Harbour City led 2-0 early with goals at 45' and 47' minutes by Elias Okafor and Marek Barros despite low xG (0.111 and 0.009). [#905][#975]
- Seabrook Town rallied with 4 second-half goals including two late goals (90+2' and 90+3') by Kian Romano with very high xG values (0.609 and 0.959). [#1882][#1906]
- Seabrook Town improved press intensity and directness around 65' minutes to chase the game, leading to equalizing and winning goals. [#1361]
- Marek Barros was player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a 9.8 rating despite losing side. [#975]

- Harbour City’s opener at 45’ came from a patient, prolonged buildup involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and style of patient short passing. Marek Barros assisted a low-xG through ball to Elias Okafor who finished from 13.9m under control, showing their emphasis on methodical chance creation rather than fast breaks [#904,905].
- The second goal by Harbour City (47’) followed a corner situation, with a very low xG shot from 43.9m by Barros after a cross, highlighting set-piece utilization in their formation, though this goal was more opportunistic than reflective of their primary style [#973,975].
- Seabrook Town’s comeback started with Tariq Marlowe’s goal at 53’ right after a ball regain, illustrating their 3-4-3 formation’s pressing and ability to exploit turnovers for quick, direct finishing without buildup passes, consistent with their wide, crossing play and attacking width [#1103,1104].
- After tactical adjustments at 65’ to press higher and play more direct, Seabrook Town’s increased attacking intensity led to Callum Varga’s equaliser at 69’ off a quick 3-pass sequence starting from a regain, showing an effective counter-press to recover possession and immediately target the box, playing through the wide spaces and forwards of their 3-4-3 setup [#1361,1447,1448].
- In the final minutes, Seabrook Town scored twice rapidly (90+2’, 90+3’) on a counter and open play buildup involving quick regains and through passes, reflecting their high pressing, quick transition style, effective use of wide players and the front three to overload spaces behind Harbour City’s defense as they chased the game [#1881,1882,1905,1906].
- Harbour City’s late tactical change to press higher and play more direct was reactive but did not prevent Seabrook Town’s dominance in field tilt and box touches, showing the limits of their normally patient style under pressure and in transition defense [#1884].
